learning_outcomes.text: Explain ecosystem structure, biodiversity and ecosystem services
Analyse human impacts such as pollution, land-use change and resource use
Describe biogeochemical cycles including carbon, nitrogen and water
Evaluate renewable and non-renewable energy and their trade-offs
Assess sustainability and the management of common resources
Interpret environmental data and reason about uncertainty

integrative_case: A fishing town faces declining catches and algal blooms: students link nutrient pollution to the nitrogen cycle, assess land-use and energy choices, apply sustainability and common-resource management ideas, and interpret monitoring data with its uncertainty to propose a management plan.
